That's the fact, Jack!How to make it250g vintage cheddar, finely grated120g mayonnaise80g roasted red capsicum from a jar, chopped1 tsp Worcestershire sauce1/4 tsp cayenne pepper1/2 tsp paprika250g crackers4 celery sticksMix the cheddar with the mayonnaise, capsicum, Worcestershire, cayenne and pepper, keeping it a little chunky.Chill so the flavours settle.Spoon into a bowl, dust with paprika and serve with crackers and celery sticks.Psycho's don't-call-me-Francis franksCocktail franks glazed in honey, mustard and tomato sauceHow to make it30 cocktail frankfurts1 tbsp vegetable oil3 tbsp tomato sauce2 tbsp honey2 tbsp American mustard1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce1 jar wholegrain mustardScore the frankfurts diagonally a few times each.Fry in the oil until the cuts open up.Add the tomato sauce, honey, mustard and Worcestershire and toss until sticky and glazed.Serve on toothpicks with a pot of wholegrain mustard.MainsSgt Hulka's mess hall meatloafGlazed beef meatloaf baked in a loaf tinHow to make it800g beef mince3 onions, 1 grated and 2 sliced1 egg60g breadcrumbs2 tsp Worcestershire sauce4 tbsp tomato sauce1 tbsp brown sugar1kg potatoes80g butter100ml full cream milk1 tbsp plain flour400ml beef stock300g frozen peasMix the mince with the grated onion, egg, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire and salt. Press into a lined loaf tin.Spread with the tomato sauce mixed with the sugar and bake at 180°C.Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with some of the butter and the milk.Fry the sliced onions in butter, stir in the flour, then the stock, and simmer to a gravy.Cook the peas and serve everything together.Czech border chicken paprikashThe EM-50 run over the border into CzechoslovakiaHow to make it1kg chicken thigh fillets2 brown onions1 red capsicum2 tbsp sweet paprika30g butter1 tbsp plain flour400g tinned crushed tomatoes250ml chicken stock200g sour cream400g egg noodles2 Lebanese cucumbers2 tbsp white wine vinegar1 dillBrown the chicken in half the butter and set aside.Fry the sliced onions and capsicum in the same pan for 6 minutes, then stir in the paprika and flour for 1 minute.Add the tomatoes, stock and chicken and simmer for 30 minutes until tender.Thinly slice the cucumbers and toss with the vinegar, a pinch of sugar and half the dill.Cook the noodles, drain and toss with the rest of the butter.Stir the sour cream through the chicken off the heat, scatter with dill and serve with the noodles and cucumber salad.SweetsQuick brown fox fudge cakeMoist chocolate cake with fudge frostingHow to make it300g self-raising flour300g caster sugar60g cocoa powder1 tsp bicarbonate of soda2 eggs330ml full cream milk125ml vegetable oil150g dark chocolate100g butter250g icing sugar200ml thickened cream, whippedMix the flour, sugar, cocoa and bicarb. Whisk in the eggs, most of the milk, oil and boiling water.Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake at 180°C.Cool the cakes.Melt the chocolate with the butter, then beat in the icing sugar and remaining milk until thick and glossy.Sandwich and cover the cakes with the icing and serve with whipped cream.DrinksEM-50 Urban Assault Irish coffeeHot coffee, brown sugar and Irish whiskey topped with creamHow to make it800ml strong brewed coffee3 tbsp brown sugar160ml Irish whiskey150ml thickened creamWarm heatproof glasses with hot water, then tip it out.Stir the sugar and whiskey into each glass, then fill with hot coffee to near the top.Lightly whip the cream until it just thickens but still pours.Pour the cream slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
